name: W. Steube
bio: a Representative from Florida; born in Bradenton, Manatee County, Fla., May 19, 1978; graduated from Southeast High School, Bradenton, Fla., 1996; B.S., University of Florida, Gainesville, Fla., 2000; J.D., University of Florida, Gainesville, Fla., 2003; United States Army, 2004-2008, Operation Iraqi Freedom, 2006-2007; member of the Florida state house of representatives, 2010-2016; member of the Florida state senate, 2016-2018; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Sixteenth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2019-present).
